QUOTE: "So the dependency stops at the inference layer and the facade. The C ABI and the Python wrapper don't see it."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the dependency is concentrated in the inference layer but never says it is not contained there. It names `src/facade/entropic.cpp` as including `llama_cpp_backend.h` and says the C++ public headers leak, but it then concludes that the dependency "stops at the inference layer and the facade". It doesn't conclude that a minority of reaching files sit outside `src/inference`.
